title: Imurika ry'abapfushije
intro: Ugiye guhura n'ubugingo bwageragejwe n'itandukaniro rikomeye, amaso yabwo yari azi ururimi rw'amarira ariko umutima wabwo ntiwigeze utakaza icyizere. Mu nkuru y'uburiganya, irarikira, ndetse n'ihumure ry'uko amaherezo wasubiye guhura, uyu mugaragu mwiza wa Allah yabaye ikimenyetso cy'ukwihangana iteka ryose. Ni nde wihanganiye imyaka y'ububabare bwihishe, ariko akabona kandi akongera kubona no kwishima mu kanya gato?
clues: Ndi umuhanuzi izina rye ryabaye ikimenyetso cy'ukwihangana mu gihe cyo gutakaza byinshi.
Nahawe umugisha wo kugira abahungu benshi, ariko umwe yanyazwe n'ishyari ry'abandi.
Urukundo nakunze uwo muntu wari warazimiye rwari rukomeye cyane ku buryo amaso yanjye yahindutse umweru kubera agahinda, nyamara sinigeze ninubira uretse Allah gusa.
Nohereje abahungu banjye ngo bajye gushaka uwo nari natakaje na murumuna we, mbasaba kudacika intege.
Ubwo uwari uzanye inkuru nziza yahageraga, nambaye ishati mu maso, maze mu buryo butunguranye isi yongera kuba nziza.
Nitwa Isirayeli, kandi mu bahungu banjye cumi na babiri havutse imiryango cumi n'ibiri y'ubwoko bukomeye.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
